title: CLI Hangs on Large Text Paste Input
body:
**Bug Description**
There are instances where the cli becomes unresponsive after trying to paste in text. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 1.0.7
- Feedback ID: 72938e49-67ca-4c1f-9b3d-8312b41d987c
